title: SBI Issues ₹4,691 Crore Basel III-Compliant AT-1 Perpetual Bonds
summary: Raises core Tier-I regulatory capital with a coupon rate of 7.75% and 5-year call option.

blocks.content: Raises core Tier-I regulatory capital with a coupon rate of 7.75% and 5-year call option.

items: Issuance Details: ₹4,691 crore raised via Basel III Additional Tier 1 (AT1) perpetual bonds at 7.75% coupon.
Loss Absorbency: AT1 bonds feature loss absorbency (can be written off or converted to equity during stress).

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Basel III norms mandate minimum total capital ratio of 9% plus capital conservation buffer.
